verdict.rationale: Outlook ships its own background automation in the form of Inbox rules, which process incoming messages automatically (for example, forwarding them) and can be created programmatically through the Graph API. That covers event-triggered, rule-based automation on incoming mail only. Change notifications and the mail APIs are developer building blocks for constructing automations and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring autonomous automations, AI or agentic automation beyond static rules, automations beyond incoming-mail triggers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Apps can set up [Inbox rules](/en-us/graph/api/resources/messagerule) to promptly handle incoming messages and reduce email clutter.
Use Inbox rules to automate actions such as forwarding specific incoming messages
